Why Choose Us

Why We Are Different From Other Gold Jewellery Buyers

We use a German Karat Meter Machine for accurate, non-destructive and internationally trusted purity testing — and we show you everything.

❌ Oldest Method To Test The Purity

  • ❌ This method is completely inaccurate — judged by eye
  • ❌ Cheapest and easily available in the market
  • ❌ Scratches jewellery and uses acid
  • ❌ Often gives a lower value than the actual purity

✅ German Karat Meter Machine

  • ✅ German Karatmeter testing — worldwide certified technology
  • ✅ A non-destructive method, widely used and appreciated
  • ✅ Provides the exact value of purity in karat & % — e.g. 22kt / 91.6%
  • ✅ Result on screen, in front of you
